content:
On Jul 15, 2026, Optimism saw significant progress in Superchain interoperability with new Super-range and Super-root features, alongside extensive documentation restructuring and critical bug fixes across core clients. Key efforts also focused on refining OPCM V800 templates and addressing issues related to brotli decompression and test flakiness, while the circulating supply data was updated.

## 🚨 Needs Attention
- **Urgent Discussions**:
    - `op-proposer`: select proposal sources by root format instead of interop mode ([#21710](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/21710)): Discussions are ongoing regarding how `op-proposer` classifies proposal sources, with a recommendation to rename CLI options to make user intent more explicit.
- **New Issues**:
    - Kona Brotli Decoder Leniency ([#21793](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/21793)): The `brotli-decompressor` in Kona is more lenient than `op-node`'s, accepting malformed channels that `op-node` rejects, which could lead to consensus issues.

## ✅ Completed Work
### Superchain Interoperability & Fault Proofs
- Executed Super-range consolidation proofs within the Kona SP1 guest, enhancing fault proof mechanisms. ([#21677](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21677))
- Implemented Super-range range proofs in the Kona SP1 guest. ([#21671](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21671))
- Added support for Super-root fault games at initial deployment, ensuring alignment with `SUPER_ROOT_GAMES_MIGRATION`. ([#21720](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21720))
- Prepared and used production Super-root proposal sources in e2e tests. ([#21742](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21742), [#21738](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21738))
- Validated ZK after Super-root migration. ([#21771](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21771))

### Core Client Consistency & Bug Fixes
- Standardized the operator opt-in flag for SDM PostExec across clients. ([#21551](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21551))
- Fixed a bug in `op-acceptance-tests` that incorrectly set fork schedules. ([#21642](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21642))
- Updated the `op-reth` client to include a fix for `validate_block_post_execution_with_hashed_state`. ([#21766](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21766))
- Closed three unauthenticated attack surfaces in the Kona client. ([#21753](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21753))
- Made the batch upgrade test `SUPER_ROOT_GAMES_MIGRATION`-aware. ([#21803](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21803))

### Documentation Restructuring & Enhancements
- Moved the chain-operator network design example from reference to guides. ([#21770](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21770))
- Surfaced node system requirements on the node-operator overview. ([#21761](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21761))
- Added a snapshot restore how-to guide for node operators. ([#21819](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21819))
- Split several documentation pages by mode to improve user experience, including app-developer standard-bridge and integrating-wallets ([#21818](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21818)), governance FAQ ([#21817](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21817)), Kona pages ([#21816](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21816)), node-operator supernode and legacy-geth ([#21815](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21815)), flashblocks ([#21814](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21814)), batcher configuration ([#21813](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21813)), op-deployer releases ([#21812](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21812)), and op-conductor ([#21796](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21796)).
- Fixed dead-end and chained legacy redirects. ([#21781](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21781))

### Tokenomics Data Update
- The circulating supply was updated from 2,159,485,520 to 2,281,750,034, verified against the canonical tokenomics sheet. ([#1340](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/pull/1340))

### Active Discussions
- **ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops**
    - Flaky Test: `TestExecutePayloadSuccess` ([#19898](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/19898)): Reopened due to recurrence of a proofs ExEx store readiness race; a new fix ([#21807](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21807)) addresses this by waiting for the later of both receipt blocks.
    - `op-reth-test-engine`: minimal in-test EL for `op-e2e/actions` ([#20415](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/20415)): The `op-reth-test-engine` is now complete, with full implementation as a draft stack, supporting FCU-with-attrs and aligning with Engine API semantics.
- **ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io**
    - Flaky Test: `TestExecutePayloadSuccess` ([#19898](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/issues/19898)): Reopened due to a recurrence of the proofs ExEx store readiness race in `TestL2MultipleTransactionsInSingleBlock`. A fix in #21807 addresses this by waiting through the later of both receipt blocks.
    - `op-reth-test-engine`: minimal in-test EL for `op-e2e/actions` ([#20415](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/issues/20415)): The engine is now complete, and the full track is implemented as a draft stack. FCU-with-attrs is now supported, and processed payloads remain non-canonical until an FCU makes them head.

## 🐞 Issue Triage
### New Issues
- **ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops**
    - Kona Brotli Decoder Leniency ([#21793](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/21793)): The `brotli-decompressor` used in Kona is more lenient than `op-node`'s `andybalholm` decoder, accepting malformed channels that `op-node` rejects, which could lead to consensus issues.
- **ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io**
    - Kona Protocol Discrepancies ([#21793](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/issues/21793)): A new issue was opened to address the observation that the `brotli-decompressor` used in Kona is more lenient than the `andybalholm` decoder used in op-node, accepting malformed channels that op-node rejects.

### Closed Issues
- **ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops**
    - Kona Host Game Input and Witness Generation Review ([#18430](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/18430)): Closed, with further tracking in a separate issue.
    - Kona Brotli Decompression Protocol Adjustment ([#20666](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/20666)): Closed as "won't-fix" after differential testing revealed the proposed change would not improve parity and could reduce it.
- **ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io**
    - Kona Protocol Enhancements ([#20666](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/issues/20666)): The issue regarding switching `decompress_brotli` to `BrotliDecompressCustomIoCustomDict` for incremental-flush parity with op-node was closed as "won't-fix".
    - Kona Protocol Enhancements ([#18430](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/issues/18430)): The review of host game input and witness generation for soundness in Kona was closed, with further tracking moved to a new issue.
